name: Divider
layerWhy: It arranges other parts by space; it keeps no promise to the person of its own.
promise: What is before and after are different sections.
expectation: A thin line where one section ends and the next begins.
evidence: It is drawn only where that meaning holds; between controls it stands upright.
behaviour: Horizontal in a stack; vertical in a row or toolbar.
context: Between sections, between groups of controls.
dont: Lines between every row of a form.
